observations: Photo 0 shows two framed solar panels standing upright outdoors on grass, leaning against a rough concrete wall.
Panels appear to be monocrystalline (dark cells with white/silver grid lines) with light-colored aluminum frames.
A faint watermark is visible on the panels but no readable brand, model, or wattage label.
Background shows a motorcycle and a residential compound, consistent with an outdoor Abuja setting.
No visible cracks, hotspots, or frame damage from this distance, but image resolution is too low to confirm cell condition.
No specification sticker (wattage, voltage, current) is visible on the front of either panel.

claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specializes in all solar equipment such as inverter, panels, charge controllers
claims.evidence: General business claim about the seller's trade; photo only shows two panels, not the full claimed range of equipment.

risks.risk: Wattage and voltage rating of the panels are unknown, which is the primary driver of solar panel price
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the specification sticker on the back of each panel showing wattage, Voc, Isc, Vmp, Imp
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since price varies by multiples depending on wattage class

risks.risk: Actual power output / working condition is unverified
risks.proof: A clip or photo of a multimeter or solar charge controller reading while the panel is in direct sun

risks.risk: Hidden micro-cracks or hotspots in the cells not visible at this photo distance
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each cell's surface in good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/functional condition unknown, worst case

risks.risk: Frame or junction box corrosion/damage not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Close-up photo of frame corners and the rear junction box/cables
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible wear, worst case

risks.risk: Age and usage history (years in service, prior storm/weather exposure) cannot be seen
risks.proof: Seller statement with photo evidence of purchase date or installation history
risks.if_unproven: treated as unknown age, priced conservatively

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rear specification label on each panel (wattage, Voc, Isc, Vmp, Imp)
Photo or video of the panel connected to a charge controller/multimeter showing live output in sunlight
Close-up photos of the cell surfaces for cracks or discoloration
Close-up photo of the frame corners and junction box/cable condition
response.reason: The panels cannot even be priced at a worst-case level because wattage/voltage rating, which determines the solar panel's price bracket, is not readable in the single photo provided.
